efficiency.description: Per-player rushing and receiving efficiency plus XFP/XTD expectation; season to date.
efficiency.label: Efficiency (rushing, receiving, total, expected fantasy points)

line_matchups.description: Team rush/pass grades, pressure and run-block metrics paired with the next opponent defence (teams on bye are absent).
line_matchups.label: Offensive line vs defensive front matchups (next game)

offense_snaps.description: Snap counts and snap share with goal-line and red-zone splits.
offense_snaps.label: Offensive snaps (total, rushing, passing, inside 5/10/20)

passing_advanced.description: QB accuracy, pressure, time-to-throw, depth and fantasy production.
passing_advanced.label: Passing advanced (QB)

passing_depth.description: QB attempts, completions, yards and rate by depth bucket.
passing_depth.label: Passing by depth (QB)

qb_coverage_matchup.description: QB production against each coverage family and the next opponent defence mix (OPP is the upcoming opponent).
qb_coverage_matchup.label: QB vs coverage matchup (next game)

receiving_advanced.description: Route share, targets, air yards, first-read, designed targets, alignment route split, expected fantasy points.
receiving_advanced.label: Receiving advanced

receiving_man_vs_zone.description: Per-route production against man, zone, single-high and two-high shells.
receiving_man_vs_zone.label: Receiving: man vs zone, single-high vs two-high

receiving_routes_run.description: Routes, targets and per-route production split by wide/slot/inline/backfield.
receiving_routes_run.label: Routes run by alignment

receiving_separation_by_alignment.description: Separation score and win rate overall and from wide/slot/inline/backfield.
receiving_separation_by_alignment.label: Separation by alignment

receiving_separation_by_breaks.description: Separation score and win rate by horizontal/vertical/static/shallow route breaks.
receiving_separation_by_breaks.label: Separation by route break type

receiving_separation_by_coverage.description: Separation score and win rate against man, zone, red zone and Cover 2/3/4/6.
receiving_separation_by_coverage.label: Separation by coverage

receiving_separation_by_routes.description: Separation, route share and win rate by route tree (slant, out, dig, hitch, comeback, corner, post, go, ...).
receiving_separation_by_routes.label: Separation by route type

run_pass_report.description: Team snaps, pass and rush counts and rates by half, field position, score state, distance and down.
run_pass_report.label: Team run/pass report by situation

rushing_advanced.description: Explosive/success/stuff rates, yards before/after contact, zone vs man/gap concept splits, expected fantasy points.
rushing_advanced.label: Rushing advanced

rushing_bell_cow.description: Player share of team snaps, rushes, routes, targets and expected fantasy points.
rushing_bell_cow.label: Backfield opportunity share (bell cow)

wr_coverage_matchup.description: Receiver production against each coverage family and the next opponent defence mix (OPP is the upcoming opponent).
wr_coverage_matchup.label: Receiver vs coverage matchup (next game)
